scope: offline disposable PostgreSQL only; no cluster, live database, or active workshop access

green_local.reason: database integration is conditional without EVENT_TEST_DATABASE_URL

green_postgres.database: temporary local PostgreSQL 16 container removed after the run

claims: Competing requests from independent store instances cannot overbook one supply envelope.
Concurrent and sequential identical retries converge on one durable decision and hold.
Rejected decisions survive process restart and never create partial reservations.
Release requires a SHA-256 cleanup evidence identifier and conflicting replay is rejected.
A released hold becomes available to a later whole-workshop request.
non_claims: No production database migration was applied.
No live capacity source, scheduler, API route, or workshop lifecycle was connected.
No cluster failover, provisioning, or reclaim behavior is certified by this evidence.
